automationRecovery.detail: Opening the second result overlay and a subsequent AX snapshot timed out with Daemon request timed out. Existing commands were polled to completion; the shortcut was not restarted.
automationRecovery.evidence: BackgroundShortcutRunner log showed the computed Empty result. A simctl screenshot completed and showed that result with Done. After the failed snapshot became terminal, a coordinate tap on the observed Done button completed and normal AX inspection recovered. The third result then appeared.
automationRecovery.screenshotFallback: The Empty image was captured by simctl; other images used agent-device.

nativeCoverage: All three predicates at six runtime negative/fractional, zero, interior-surrogate, scalar-boundary and out-of-range positions
Correct distinction between includes searching forward and startsWith matching the exact start
endsWith uses an end position and rejects a search longer than the available prefix
Empty search matches all clamped positions, including inside surrogate pairs
Helper state resets across nested loop invocations
Receiver and needle captured before later position argument mutation
limitations: Positive positions use native scalar-advance loops and add overhead for long prefixes.
Non-finite positions, implicit coercion and RegExp search arguments remain unsupported.
Native runtime verified on a simulator, not a physical iPhone.
